people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem

translations.web: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.
